correctness.rationale: C PASS: For each n≥4, classify intersecting families of two-subsets as a face of a single vertex-star simplex or a unique three-edge triangle. The explicit face-poset map F↦phi(F) is permutation-equivariant and sends nested faces to nested target faces; the union of star simplices retracts onto the barycentric complete graph, on which the map is a homotopy equivalence; each exceptional triangle maps homeomorphically to the corresponding target 2-cell. Relative cellular gluing makes the map an ordinary homotopy equivalence. The full simplex 2-skeleton has Htilde_2=ker(iota_epsilon:Λ^3 Z^n→Λ^2 Z^n)=Λ^3 ker(epsilon) integrally. The standard hook representation, signed-cycle generating formula and Young-block invariant computation follow. Reproducible code independently tests face-image comparability, all flag homeomorphisms, group equivariance, signed Lefschetz traces, modular ranks and all block compositions in small sizes. No finite extrapolation is used in the universal argument.

originality.rationale: O PASS relative to indexed and inspected evidence: Barmak gives exactly the ordinary wedge rank for the same full Kneser independence complex, but no symmetric-group module or natural equivariant map; the published stable-graph and higher-subset literature concerns different objects. The new claim is a canonical integral representation and the complete block-permutation quotient rational homology, not the known nonequivariant Betti number. The indexed literature and comparable published mathematical statements were searched by object, parameters and implication; neither a covering result nor an equivalent formulation was identified. Publication priority in unindexed sources is an explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent equivariant construction under a different name might occur in unindexed literature; database absence is not proof of priority
Some related works were inspected at abstract or introduction level only, particularly the stable-Hom study; their different objects reduce but do not eliminate literature risk

value.rationale: V PASS: This is the complete natural integral Z[S_n]-homology module and an explicit relabeling-equivariant homotopy-equivalence map for an infinite canonical two-subset Kneser family, not an arbitrary graph example or a restatement of its published Betti numbers. The sharp formula beta_2(|Ind(KG(n,2))|/(S_{m1}×...×S_{mr});Q)=C(r-1,3) gives a new and mathematically motivated symmetry-breaking threshold: four distinguishable classes suffice regardless of class sizes; one to three do not. The naturality and integral lattice encode information invisible in nonequivariant wedge classification. Publication priority subject to unindexed equivalent works; no integral quotient torsion is claimed.
